results.snippet: Then there’s Repatha, which helped make “patent” a key word in the company’s chronicles of 2016 and 2017. The PCSK9 inhibitor has been at the center of a closely watched, back-and-forth patent battle with Sanofi and Regeneron’s Praluent, which Amgen was determined to pull off the market. Neither drug has launched in the zero-to-blockbuster way the companies had hoped, making every bit of sales count. The two sides also put up another fight over blockbuster-to-be Dupixent.
